name: knowledgeiq-golden-v1
description: Labeled Q&A set over the synthetic enterprise corpus in data/evaluation/corpus. Relevance labels are defined per source document plus evidence keywords; chunk-level ground truth is derived by matching labeled evidence keywords against ingested chunks (see app/evaluation/dataset.py).

queries.question: What are the safety requirements for machine maintenance?
How many days of paid annual leave are full-time employees entitled to?
What are the password and multi-factor authentication requirements?
ideal_points: MFA mandatory for VPN, email, admin consoles

queries.question: What are the standard payment terms for vendors?
ideal_points: net-45 possible for strategic vendors with CFO approval

queries.question: Who is authorized to perform machine maintenance and open machine guards?
How should a suspected security incident be reported and within what time?
ideal_points: critical incidents escalated to CISO within 4 hours

queries.question: What is the maximum number of annual leave days that can be carried over?
ideal_points: maximum of 5 unused days carried over

queries.question: What is the company's rocket launch checklist procedure?
ideal_points: should refuse: no document covers rocket launches
